title_translated: 幻觉作为特性而非缺陷：评估一种多智能体架构将推测性语言模型输出转化为可检验科学假设
summary_translated: 当代大语言模型（LLMs）日益倾向于抑制幻觉，优先于组合式创造力而强调事实检索。虽然这对缓解虚假信息至关重要，但这种对齐也可能通过鼓励本研究操作性定义为语义过拟合和多样性崩溃的方式，限制了推测性研发（R&D）。本文提出一种基于Rust的多智能体编排系统，以叙事白日梦与执行控制之间的对比为功能类比，而非神经认知主张。该系统在高熵生成智能体与基于网络的评估智能体之间建立认识论摩擦循环，由一个低熵语义瓶颈中介，旨在减少噪声与重复。初步实验在物理与社会科学领域生成了多样且可评估可行性的假设。我们还报告了一项探索性成对基线与消融研究，比较完整系统与直接提示、自我反思、移除语义过滤器、移除搜索依据、移除横向视角等条件。结果显示，直接提示在多数观测指标中表现最弱，但并未显示出完整系统普遍优于简单自我反思。相反，结果表明每种架构以不同方式在原创性、可行性、多样性与实证基础之间权衡，且完整系统的主要优势在于假设必须经受强物理、实证或制度约束时。这些发现并不表明幻觉本身有用；它们表明，只有在架构约束、实证基础和显式评估的共同作用下，推测性生成才具有价值。

summary: Standard multi-head attention (MHA) gives every head the same full causal context span, although heads can serve different contextual roles. Some heads may rely mainly on nearby lexical or syntactic context, while others may depend on longer-range relations such as entity interactions, discourse links, or state changes. We present Asymmetric Attention Heads (AAH), a head-wise context- allocation framework that treats context length as an explicit per-head or per-group allocation variable. AAH groups heads using feature-derived statistics, organizes these groups hierarchically, and assigns causal local windows while preserving the standard flat MHA output interface. In 4096- token seed-0 experiments, several AAH-style local-allocation variants achieve lower validation loss than pure full attention. Short-budget ablations show that stable local allocation and head-window assignment structure matter, while fixed/local controls can be competitive with adaptive hierarchy. We interpret AAH as a structured head-wise context-allocation mechanism for quality and analysis, with Attention Coverage Ratio (ACR) reported as a selected-window routing diagnostic
title: Asymmetric Attention Heads: Structured Head-Wise Context Allocation for Transformer Attention
title_translated: 非对称注意力头：Transformer注意力中的结构化头级上下文分配
summary_translated: 标准的多头注意力（MHA）为每个头提供相同的完整因果上下文范围，尽管各头可能承担不同的上下文角色。某些头可能主要依赖于附近的词汇或句法上下文，而其他头则可能依赖于更长距离的关系，如实体交互、话语联系或状态变化。我们提出了非对称注意力头（AAH），一种基于头级别的上下文分配框架，将上下文长度作为显式的每头或每组分配变量。AAH利用特征衍生的统计信息对头进行分组，构建层次化结构，并分配因果局部窗口，同时保持标准的扁平MHA输出接口。在4096-token seed-0实验中，几种AAH风格的局部分配变体达到了比纯全注意力更低的验证损失。短预算消融实验表明，稳定的局部分配和头窗口分配结构至关重要，而固定/局部控制策略也可与自适应层次结构相竞争。我们将AAH解释为一种用于质量评估与分析的结构化头级上下文分配机制，并报告了注意力覆盖比率（ACR）作为选定窗口路由的诊断指标。

summary: Bioinformatics software and databases are essential components of modern life science research, yet their mentions in the scientific literature are often inconsistent and difficult to systematically identify at scale. The lack of a comprehensive and up-to-date catalog of bioinformatics resources hinders efforts toward automated biomedical knowledge extraction and streamlined data analysis. Here we present SNAIL, a hybrid named entity recognition framework designed to automatically identify bioinformatics software and database (SW/DB) names from biomedical texts. SNAIL integrates complementary lexical and semantic modeling strategies. The lexical component captures orthographic patterns and contextual cues characteristic of SW/DB names, while the semantic component leverages contextual embeddings generated by transformer-based language models such as SciBERT, combined with an explicit token-masking strategy to enhance entity-focused representations. A large training corpus was constructed automatically through a hybrid pipeline that integrates citation-hinted extraction with large language model-assisted distillation. Evaluation on two independent benchmark datasets and real-world research articles demonstrates that SNAIL substantially outperforms existing approaches, including domain-specific methods such as bioNerDS2 and general-purpose large language models such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Claude. Applying SNAIL to large-scale literature analysis further reveals distinct journal-level preferences across bioinformatics subfields. These results demonstrate that SNAIL provides an accurate and scalable solution for identifying bioinformatics resources in scientific texts and enables systematic meta-analysis of tool usage and research trends.
title: Automatic bioinformatic software named entity recognition from literature
title_translated: 从文献中自动识别生物信息学软件命名实体
summary_translated: 生物信息学软件和数据库是现代生命科学研究的重要组成部分，但它们在科学文献中的提及往往不一致且难以大规模系统识别。缺乏全面且最新的生物信息学资源目录，阻碍了自动化生物医学知识提取和数据流程优化。本文提出SNAIL，一种混合命名实体识别框架，旨在自动从生物医学文本中识别生物信息学软件和数据库（SW/DB）名称。SNAIL整合了互补的词法和语义建模策略：词法部分捕捉SW/DB名称特有的拼写模式和上下文线索；语义部分利用基于Transformer的语言模型（如SciBERT）生成的上下文嵌入，并结合显式的标记掩码策略以增强实体聚焦表示。通过融合引用提示提取与大语言模型辅助蒸馏的混合管道，自动构建了一个大规模训练语料库。在两个独立基准数据集和真实科研文章上的评估表明，SNAIL显著优于现有方法，包括领域特定方法（如bioNerDS2）和通用大语言模型（如ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok和Claude）。将SNAIL应用于大规模文献分析进一步揭示了不同生物信息学子领域在期刊层面的工具偏好差异。结果表明，SNAIL为科学文本中生物信息学资源的识别提供了准确且可扩展的解决方案，并支持工具使用和研究趋势的系统性元分析。

summary: Text summarization refers to the task of condensing a document into a shorter version while preserving its key information. Automatic text summarization (ATS), driven by advancements in natural language processing (NLP), has developed rapidly in recent years. ATS methods are commonly categorized by input type (such as single-document or multi-document summarization) and by output type (extractive, abstractive, and hybrid). This article presents a focused review of modern summarization techniques with an emphasis on transformer based models and large language models (LLMs), specifically BERT, RoBERTa and BART. It examines their architectures, pretraining strategies, and their suitability for extractive and abstractive summarization tasks.
title: Transformer Models for Text Summarization: A Comparative Study of BART, BERT, and RoBERTa
title_translated: 用于文本摘要的Transformer模型：BART、BERT与RoBERTa的比较研究
summary_translated: 文本摘要是指在保留文档关键信息的前提下，将其压缩为较短版本的任务。近年来，在自然语言处理（NLP）技术进步推动下，自动文本摘要（ATS）发展迅速。ATS方法通常按输入类型（如单文档或多文档摘要）和输出类型（抽取式、抽象式和混合式）分类。本文聚焦于现代摘要技术的综述，重点探讨基于Transformer的模型和大型语言模型（LLMs），特别是BERT、RoBERTa和BART。文章分析了它们的架构设计、预训练策略及其在抽取式和抽象式摘要任务中的适用性。

summary: We describe the evolution of a virtual assistant, called ATHENA, designed to support the capture, retrieval, and dissemination of knowledge for members of a Community of Practice (CoP) related to the Oil and Gas sector. An evaluation of a first prototype involving 75 professionals from the Society of Petroleum Engineering (SPE) showed that ATHENA dramatically improved both their productivity and performance equality on a set of realistic well-planning tasks compare to their use of a state-of-the-art RAG baseline system. However, the evaluation also identified areas for improvement. This paper describes technical advances to our first prototype in the areas of multi-document retrieval, support for answer validation, and more focused proactive dissemination. Evaluation results show that this enhanced version of ATHENA provides better support for completing knowledge-intensive tasks related to well planning than does a state-of-the-art baseline. ATHENA has been integrated into the SPE Research Portal and is being deployed for use by the society's membership.
title: A Virtual Member of a Community of Practice for the Society of Petroleum Engineers: From Prototype to Deployment
title_translated: 面向石油与天然气行业实践共同体的虚拟成员：从原型到部署
summary_translated: 我们描述了名为ATHENA的虚拟助手的演进过程，该助手旨在支持石油与天然气行业实践共同体（CoP）成员的知识捕获、检索与传播。对首批原型的评估涉及来自石油工程师协会（SPE）的75名专业人士，结果显示，与使用最先进的RAG基线系统相比，ATHENA显著提升了他们在一系列真实井规划任务中的生产力和绩效均等性。然而，评估也识别出改进空间。本文介绍了在多文档检索、答案验证支持以及更精准主动传播方面的技术改进。评估结果表明，改进后的ATHENA版本在支持井规划相关知识密集型任务方面优于当前最先进的基线系统。ATHENA已集成至SPE研究门户，并正在向该协会成员部署使用。

summary: Travel behavior research increasingly combines digital data collection with predictive modeling, yet these stages are often developed and evaluated separately. This study proposes a three-agent workflow integrating conversational data collection, structured data processing, and behavioral prediction. A chatbot-administered, image-augmented stated-preference survey collected mode choices from student commuters across five predefined weather scenarios, yielding 454 respondent-scenario observations. Weather-related associations were analyzed using a multinomial logit model, while logistic regression and random forest provided machine-learning benchmarks. Nine locally deployed large language models (LLMs), ranging from 2 to 35 billion parameters, were evaluated across four zero-shot prompt-and-context conditions and extended through persona, few-shot, and vision-based configurations. Random forest achieved 69.6% five-class accuracy, while the best text-only zero-shot LLM reached 69.9% without task-specific fitting. Habitual travel information produced the most consistent gains, Expert framing generally outperformed Role-Play, and persona information was most useful when habitual travel information was unavailable. Few-shot prompting improved prediction for several models, with gains stabilizing after a small number of examples. Using the same weather images shown to respondents, the best vision-based configuration reached 71.5% five-class accuracy, indicating that visual context may provide additional predictive information for selected models. Overall, the study shows how conversational surveys, structured data processing, conventional behavioral modeling, machine learning, and multimodal LLM prediction can be coordinated within an auditable multi-agent workflow.
title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction
title_translated: 一种智能体驱动的主动数据收集、出行行为建模与天气敏感需求预测方法
summary_translated: 出行行为研究越来越多地结合数字数据收集与预测建模，但这些阶段通常被分别开发和评估。本研究提出一个三智能体工作流，整合对话式数据收集、结构化数据处理与行为预测。一个由聊天机器人管理的、图像增强的陈述偏好调查，从五种预设天气情景下的学生通勤者中收集出行方式选择，共获得454个受访者-情景观测数据。使用多元逻辑回归模型分析天气相关关联，同时采用逻辑回归和随机森林作为机器学习基准。评估了九个本地部署的大语言模型（LLM），参数规模从2亿到35亿不等，在四种零样本提示与上下文条件下，并通过角色设定、少样本提示和视觉配置进行扩展。随机森林达到69.6%的五分类准确率，而最佳纯文本零样本LLM在无需任务特定微调的情况下达到69.9%。习惯性出行信息带来最一致的提升，专家表述通常优于角色扮演，当缺乏习惯性出行信息时，角色信息最为有用。少样本提示提升了多个模型的预测性能，增益在少量示例后趋于稳定。使用与受访者相同的天气图像，最佳视觉配置达到71.5%的五分类准确率，表明视觉上下文可能为部分模型提供额外的预测信息。总体而言，本研究展示了如何在一个可审计的多智能体工作流中协调对话调查、结构化数据处理、传统行为建模、机器学习及多模态LLM预测。

summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a better objective or update rule improves the compute\mbox{-}capability exchange rate for every subsequent run, including the one that produces the next agent. Whether RSI is feasible therefore turns on whether an agent can design training algorithms. No benchmark isolates that ability: existing suites are won by collecting data or by tuning hyperparameters, and none tells a change to how a run is executed apart from a change to how the model learns. We present AI4AI\mbox{-}Bench, 10 frozen research repositories spanning 10 training algorithm families. In each task, an agent has 4 hours on one B300 to rewrite the training algorithm; its code is then rerun from scratch for up to 12 hours and scored by a fixed evaluator hidden from the agent, against the repository's original algorithm under the same procedure. Because the 10 metrics are incommensurable, every task is mapped onto one scale on which $0$ is an uninformative model, $0.1$ is the algorithm the repository ships, and $1.0$ is the task optimum. Across 29 configurations of 6 systems on all 10 tasks the mean score is $0.166$, and the best system reaches $0.250$: even the strongest closes under a fifth of the distance between the algorithm that was already there and the optimum. The submissions show where that distance went: most never change how the model learns at all, and the minority that do average $0.226$ against $0.126$ for the rest. More reasoning effort mostly buys the willingness to go there, taking that minority from $8\%$ of submissions to $64\%$ and the mean score from $0.094$ to $0.196$. We release the task suite, the evaluators and every scored submission, so that the measurement can be repeated as these systems change.
title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
title_translated: AI4AI-Bench：用于递归自我改进的算法设计中大语言模型智能体的基准测试
summary_translated: 递归自我改进（RSI）探讨的是AI系统能否改进生成AI系统的流程，从而使下一个系统继承该改进。这一流程即为训练算法：更优的目标函数或更新规则能提升每次后续运行的计算能力交换效率，包括生成下一个智能体的那一次。因此，RSI是否可行取决于智能体能否设计训练算法。目前尚无基准能单独衡量这种能力：现有套件的胜利通常依赖于数据收集或超参数调优，且没有一个能区分执行方式的变化与学习方式的变化。我们提出了AI4AI-Bench，包含10个冻结的研究仓库，涵盖10类训练算法家族。在每个任务中，智能体有4小时在一台B300上重写训练算法；其代码随后从头开始重新运行最多12小时，并由隐藏的固定评估器评分，与仓库原始算法在相同流程下对比。由于10个指标不可通约，每个任务都被映射到一个尺度上，其中0代表无信息模型，0.1代表仓库发布的算法，1.0代表任务最优解。在6个系统在全部10个任务上的29种配置中，平均得分为0.166，最佳系统达到0.250：即使最强系统也仅接近原始算法与最优解之间距离的五分之一。提交结果揭示了差距所在：大多数从未改变模型的学习方式，而少数改变者平均得分为0.226，其余为0.126。更多推理努力主要带来尝试意愿的提升，使这类提交比例从8%升至64%，平均得分从0.094升至0.196。我们公开了任务套件、评估器及所有已评分提交，以便随着系统演进而重复测量。

summary: Whether a language model has improved itself is increasingly judged not by mean accuracy but by which individual problems it gains and loses. Tracking these transitions means differencing two noisy estimates, leaving them vulnerable to measurement artifacts. Auditing three rounds of rank-$32$ LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, we identify seven measurement failures, each of which inverts a reported finding when its control is absent. Several are standard practice. A ledger built on a single greedy decode manufactures capability changes on an untrained model, largely an artifact of inference batching; the expansion statistic separating acquisition from sharpening assigns that same model a rate of $0.280$. The natural threshold repair does not survive replication: estimated across the frozen comparisons such a design already contains, its null stays non-zero. We replace it with a per-problem exact test against a pooled baseline under false-discovery-rate control, which detects nothing on any held-out replicate and is unchanged under the multiple-testing rule, error rate and pool size. Applied to a ladder of arms matched in stream, volume and evaluation, the audit finds that external distillation improves problems the base model rarely reaches while three forms of self-training do not; a regression rejects this asymmetry as a by-product of distillation's larger overall gain ($p < 10^{-8}$). On the far smaller set of problems the base model never reaches, the evidence is inconclusive, while self-training corrupts problems solved at baseline at rates well above the measured floor. Transition-level auditing therefore requires a separately measured null for every statistic it reports: nulls that cost no new experiments, built from baseline replicates a multi-arm study already owns, though not from as few as most possess.
title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null
comment: Code and evaluation artifacts are available at this https URL
title_translated: 幻影收益：基于测量零假设的自我改进审计
summary_translated: 当前对语言模型是否实现自我改进的判断，越来越不再依赖平均准确率，而是关注其在具体问题上的增减变化。追踪这些变化需要对两个噪声估计进行差分，使其易受测量伪影影响。我们在Qwen3-8B上对三轮rank-32 LoRA自训练进行审计，对照一个通过相同流程处理的冻结控制组，发现了七种测量失败，每一种在缺少控制组时都会反转报告结果。其中一些是常规做法。基于单一贪婪解码构建的账本会在未训练模型上制造出能力变化，这主要是推理批处理造成的伪影；用于区分获取与锐化阶段的扩展统计量将同一模型赋予0.280的速率。自然阈值修复无法通过复制验证：在冻结比较中估算时，该设计本身仍保持非零。我们改用针对池化基线的逐问题精确检验，在错误发现率控制下，对保留的副本检测不到任何效果，且不受多重检验规则、误差率和池大小的影响。应用于匹配流、体积和评估的阶梯式多臂实验，审计发现外部蒸馏改善了基础模型极少触及的问题，而三种自训练形式则未见效果；回归分析表明这种不对称性是蒸馏整体增益的副产品（p < 10^-8）。对于基础模型从未触及的极小问题集，证据不充分，而自训练在基线已解决的问题上造成了远高于测量底限的破坏率。因此，过渡层面的审计要求对每个报告的统计量都配备独立测量的零假设：这些零假设无需新增实验，可基于多臂研究已拥有的基线复现，而非多数人所拥有的少量复现。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induction and text with code skill formats, the two axes along which existing methods differ. Task-level skills mostly reduce the agent's performance below its no-memory baseline while subtask-level skills raise it above on average, and text skills transfer better than code skills. To further understand our findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills: specificity, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and abstractness, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. Neither property alone predicts task success, but their combined effect does, which we propose as a skill utility score. The score correlates consistently with task success when skills are transferred, and subtask-level and text skills score higher. Computing skill utility only needs the skills and task descriptions but not any task execution, so our score serves as a practical diagnostic of a skill memory before any new task runs.
title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents
title_translated: 分解它，传递它：大语言模型智能体中的跨任务技能迁移
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以从已完成的任务中提取技能，并在后续使用以积累能力。实践中，提取的技能可能不可靠地迁移，甚至会损害检索它们的智能体。当智能体提取的技能能否可靠地跨任务迁移仍是开放问题。我们开展了一项全面且受控的研究，探讨技能提取方式如何影响其跨任务迁移。具体而言，我们比较了任务级与子任务级技能提取，以及文本与代码两种技能格式，这是现有方法的两个主要差异维度。任务级技能大多使智能体性能低于无记忆基线，而子任务级技能平均则使其高于基线；文本技能的迁移效果优于代码技能。为进一步理解结果，我们考察了提取技能的两个互补属性：特异性（衡量技能与真实任务的匹配程度）和抽象性（衡量其相关性在任务间的分布均匀性）。单一属性无法预测任务成功，但两者的联合效应可以，我们提出将其作为技能效用评分。该评分在技能迁移时与任务成功高度相关，且子任务级和文本技能得分更高。计算该评分仅需技能和任务描述，无需实际任务执行，因此可作为新任务启动前对技能记忆的实用诊断工具。

summary: Small language models are usually built like large ones and then squeezed onto a CPU afterwards. We did the opposite: we fixed the target first, one user, one token at a time, 4-bit weights, ordinary CPU, and chose the architecture to suit it. The result keeps full attention in only 6 of its 18 blocks. The other 12 use short convolutions whose memory is two timesteps wide no matter how long the conversation gets, so two thirds of the network never re-reads a growing cache.   Trained from scratch on 59.9B tokens, the model scores 47.31 on a five-task benchmark against a bar of 42.20 that was fixed before training began. It beats GPT-2 124M, Pythia-160M, OPT-125M and GPT-neo-125M, all trained on three to six times more data, and exceeds MobileLLM-125M's published score despite that model seeing a trillion tokens. Validation bits-per-byte is 0.8685.   To check the architecture rather than the training recipe, we trained a conventional all-attention model of the same size on the same data, and wrote down the winning condition before scoring either. The hybrid won the chosen quality metric by 0.81%, matched it on downstream tasks, produced a 6.3% smaller 4-bit file, and decoded 1.76x faster at 2048 tokens of context, 2.08x against an external model of similar size. In every measurement the speed advantage is near zero at an empty context and grows with length, which is what the mechanism predicts and what a merely leaner model would not show. A simple bandwidth calculation predicts only 1.17x, so memory volume alone does not explain the gap.   We also report what did not work: an unmitigated 4-bit quality cost, roughly half the convolution channels ending up inert and impossible to remove, and a vocabulary larger than this model size warrants.
title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Code, weights and the measurement artefacts behind every number: this https URL
title_translated: Daedalus-150M：专为CPU推理设计的卷积-注意力混合模型
summary_translated: 小型语言模型通常先按大型模型架构构建，再压缩到CPU上运行。我们采取相反路径：首先确定目标——单用户、逐令牌处理，4比特权重，普通CPU，然后选择适配该目标的架构。结果是，模型仅在18个模块中的6个保持完整注意力，其余12个使用短卷积，其内存宽度始终为两个时间步长，无论对话多长，因此三分之二的网络永远不会重读不断增长的缓存。在599亿个标记上从头训练，该模型在五任务基准上得分为47.31，而训练前设定的基准为42.20。它超越了GPT-2 124M、Pythia-160M、OPT-125M和GPT-neo-125M，这些模型均在三到六倍更多的数据上训练，且超过MobileLLM-125M的公开得分，尽管后者经历了万亿标记的训练。验证比特/字节为0.8685。为检验架构而非训练方案，我们在相同数据上训练了一个同规模的传统全注意力模型，并在评分前写下获胜条件。混合模型在选定质量指标上领先0.81%，在下游任务上表现一致，生成的4比特文件小6.3%，在2048令牌上下文下解码速度提升1.76倍，相比同规模外部模型快2.08倍。在所有测量中，速度优势在空上下文时接近零，随长度增加而增长，这符合机制预测，而单纯更轻量的模型不会表现出此特征。简单带宽计算仅预测1.17倍，因此内存体积无法解释这一差距。我们还报告了无效尝试：4比特质量成本未缓解，约一半卷积通道最终处于惰性状态且无法移除，词汇表规模也超出该模型尺寸应有的范围。

summary: Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, painstaking work requiring detailed attention to long documents. Scrubbing also seems to align naturally with the general capabilities expected of frontier LLMs around long-context reasoning, consistency checking, and named entity recognition (NER). Despite the economic value and potential for automation, no formal evaluations of LLMs performing contract scrubbing have been conducted. We introduce ContractScrub, the first benchmark designed to evaluate contract scrubbing capabilities, comprising contracts hand-crafted by experienced lawyers over diverse error categories such as misuse of defined terms, incorrect references, and inconsistent language. Frontier models perform surprisingly poorly with only one model reaching 0.75 macro average recall despite strong performance on seemingly related general benchmarks, demonstrating the practical limits of current models and the importance of narrowly targeted, domain-specific benchmarks for measuring real-world impact.
title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
title_translated: ContractScrub：法律合同最终审查的基准测试
summary_translated: 法律工作高度依赖大量文本处理，常被视为最易受大语言模型影响的领域之一。合同“清洗”——对交易协议进行最终审查以发现错误和不一致——尤其适合自动化，因其是例行、繁琐的工作，需要对长文档进行细致关注。清洗任务似乎也天然契合前沿大语言模型在长上下文推理、一致性检查和命名实体识别（NER）方面的通用能力。尽管具有经济价值和自动化潜力，此前尚未对执行合同清洗的大语言模型进行正式评估。我们引入ContractScrub，首个专为评估合同清洗能力而设计的基准，包含由经验丰富的律师手工制作的合同，覆盖多种错误类别，如定义术语误用、引用错误和语言不一致。前沿模型表现令人意外地差，仅有一个模型达到0.75的宏平均召回率，尽管其在看似相关的通用基准上表现良好，这凸显了当前模型的实际局限性，也强调了针对特定领域、狭义目标的基准在衡量现实影响中的重要性。

summary: Memory has become a key component of large language models, enabling them to retain information and learn from long-term interactions. However, existing memory benchmarks mainly evaluate whether information is correctly extracted, stored, and retrieved, while largely overlooking how retrieved memories reshape model reasoning and affect performance on the current task. We identify memory-induced cognitive traps: even faithfully recorded and semantically relevant memories can distort model reasoning or beliefs and degrade current task performance. To systematically evaluate these failure modes, we introduce MemTrapBench, which covers two forms of cognitive traps: Reasoning Fixation and Belief Distortion. Experiments across two model families and five representative memory frameworks show that MemTrapBench is challenging: all evaluated memory strategies underperform the no-memory setting, with even the strongest methods suffering drops of more than 10%. To mitigate these cognitive traps, we propose AdaptiveMem, a simple yet effective inference-time method that instructs LLMs to avoid memory traps. AdaptiveMem mitigates cognitive traps on MemTrapBench while preserving or improving performance on standard memory benchmarks across diverse memory frameworks.
title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
title_translated: MemTrapBench：大语言模型记忆使用中的认知陷阱基准测试
summary_translated: 记忆已成为大型语言模型的关键组件，使其能够保留信息并从长期交互中学习。然而，现有的记忆基准主要评估信息是否被正确提取、存储和检索，而很大程度上忽略了检索到的记忆如何重塑模型推理并影响当前任务的表现。我们识别出记忆引发的认知陷阱：即使忠实记录且语义相关的记忆，也可能扭曲模型的推理或信念，从而降低当前任务的性能。为系统评估这些失效模式，我们提出了MemTrapBench，涵盖两种形式的认知陷阱：推理固化和信念扭曲。在两个模型家族和五个代表性记忆框架上的实验表明，MemTrapBench具有挑战性：所有评估的记忆策略均表现不如无记忆设置，即使最强的方法也出现了超过10%的性能下降。为缓解这些认知陷阱，我们提出AdaptiveMem，一种简单但有效的推理时方法，指导大语言模型避免记忆陷阱。AdaptiveMem在MemTrapBench上有效缓解了认知陷阱，同时在多种记忆框架下保持或提升了标准记忆基准的表现。

summary: Autonomous vehicles require robust perception and decision-making capabilities to operate in diverse and unseen scenarios. While reinforcement learning and rule-based methods can provide effective control and safety mechanisms, their performance may degrade in situations requiring contextual reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding multimodal information and generating contextual reasoning, however, their use for direct vehicle control can introduce latency and hallucination risks. To address these limitations, a hybrid framework is proposed. This system uses an orchestrator to coordinate PPO-trained reinforcement learning and PID control, with LLM common-sense reasoning applied throughout the framework. LLM reasoning is further employed iteratively to refine the RL reward function for dynamic driving environments. The proposed framework is evaluated in highly randomized CARLA scenarios under diverse environmental and traffic conditions. The results demonstrate the potential of integrating LLM-based reasoning with conventional autonomous driving methods while retaining structured control and safety mechanism.
title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
title_translated: 利用大语言模型的常识推理能力实现多智能体编排以支持自动驾驶
summary_translated: 自动驾驶车辆需要具备强大的感知与决策能力，以应对多样且未见过的场景。尽管强化学习和基于规则的方法可提供有效的控制与安全机制，但在需要上下文推理的情境下其性能可能下降。大语言模型（LLMs）在理解多模态信息和生成上下文推理方面表现出强大能力，但直接用于车辆控制可能引入延迟和幻觉风险。为解决这些局限，本文提出一种混合框架：该系统使用编排器协调PPO训练的强化学习与PID控制，并在整个框架中应用LLM的常识推理。此外，LLM推理被迭代使用以动态优化强化学习的奖励函数，适应不断变化的驾驶环境。所提出的框架在CARLA平台的高随机化场景下，于多样化的环境与交通条件下进行了评估。结果表明，将基于LLM的推理与传统自动驾驶方法结合具有潜力，同时保持结构化控制与安全机制。

summary: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.
title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
comment: Full version of extended abstract accepted at ICONIP 2026 (poster)
title_translated: 基于奖励引导的自回归图生成：高效多智能体通信拓扑设计
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）通过协调多个智能体在复杂推理任务中取得优异表现，但代价是消耗大量token。近期工作ARG-Designer将这一问题重新定义为自回归图生成。然而，其训练目标并未明确激励模型生成稀疏且高效的拓扑结构。为解决这一局限，我们提出受人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）启发的奖励引导自回归图生成（RGA-Designer）。我们训练一个联合捕捉任务正确性与结构紧凑性的奖励模型，并使用该奖励模型作为反馈对预训练图生成器进行微调。我们的方法在保持ARG-Designer任务准确率的同时，平均减少了20.5%的token消耗。

summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures significantly expand model capacity without a proportional increase in computational cost. However, optimizing their hyperparameters---particularly the learning rate---at extreme scales of both model size and token budget via sweeping remains computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we propose a compute-efficient, two-step hyperparameter transfer framework that estimates optimal learning rates for training large MoE models by transferring them across scaling model widths, and subsequently extrapolating to trillion-token horizons. First, we formulate a Maximal Update Parameterization ($μ$P) adaptation for MoE architectures utilizing Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and the Muon optimizer, demonstrating that optimal learning rates transfer consistently across width-scaled models. Second, we extend this transferability along the token dimension by establishing a predictive scaling law. By applying linear regression to the optimal values derived from small proxy models on limited budgets, we successfully extrapolate the ideal learning rate to massive training horizons (e.g., 10 trillion tokens) with high fidelity ($R^2=0.95$). Consequently, this indicates that proxy training on small models is sufficient to determine the optimal learning rate for the extensive training of large-scale MoEs. We apply the proposed methodology to pretrain our foundation model (155B total, 17B active parameters) from scratch, and the stable training and evaluation results validate that optimal configurations for full-scale target models can be accurately predicted with minimal ablation costs.
title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
title_translated: 逐步扩展：大规模专家混合模型的计算高效超参数迁移
summary_translated: 专家混合（MoE）架构在不按比例增加计算成本的情况下显著扩展了模型容量。然而，通过网格搜索在极端规模（包括模型大小和token预算）下优化其超参数——尤其是学习率——仍存在计算开销过大的问题。本文提出一种计算高效的两步超参数迁移框架，通过跨模型宽度迁移最优学习率，并进一步外推至万亿token训练范围。首先，我们为MoE架构提出最大更新参数化（μP）适配方法，结合多头潜在注意力（MLA）与Muon优化器，证明最优学习率可在不同宽度缩放的模型间稳定迁移。其次，我们通过建立预测缩放定律，将这种可迁移性扩展至token维度：通过对小规模代理模型在有限预算下的最优值进行线性回归，成功高精度地外推至大规模训练范围（如10万亿token），拟合度高达$R^2=0.95$。这表明，仅在小模型上进行代理训练即可准确确定大规模MoE完整训练所需的最优学习率。我们将该方法应用于从零开始预训练我们的基础模型（总计1550亿参数，活跃参数170亿），稳定训练与评估结果验证了在极小消融成本下即可准确预测全规模目标模型的最优配置。

summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable layer of plug-in components that wraps a static environment to reshape its behavior without modifying the underlying logic. Operating through standard interfaces, EnvHarness applies across diverse domains while ensuring every reshaped environment retains its original verifier. To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts. Across five benchmarks in four domains, EnvHarness outperforms both original environments and domain-specific environment generation pipelines, achieving up to a 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps. Furthermore, EnvHarness provides a superior optimization signal for reinforcement learning, enabling continuous, targeted co-evolution of the policy and its environment.
title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
title_translated: EnvHarness：唤醒静态世界以促进智能体学习
summary_translated: 大语言模型智能体通过与环境交互进行学习，但这些环境通常是手工构建且静态的：无法察觉智能体的弱点，且随着智能体能力提升迅速变得过时。尽管近期环境生成方法试图解决此问题，但仍需领域特定流程、依赖昂贵或不可靠的验证器，且最终仍产生静态环境。为减轻从头重建环境的工程负担，我们提出环境 harness（EnvHarness），一个可编程的插件式组件层，包裹静态环境以重塑其行为，而无需修改底层逻辑。通过标准接口运行，EnvHarness适用于多种领域，并确保每个重构后的环境仍保留原始验证器。为实现自动化，我们引入EnvRigger，将其视为黑盒，通过观察策略执行轨迹来合成针对诊断缺陷的EnvHarness组件，并通过新采样进行验证。在四个领域的五个基准测试中，EnvHarness优于原始环境及领域特定环境生成流水线，在保留实例上最高提升9.0分，执行步骤减少9.8%。此外，EnvHarness为强化学习提供了更优的优化信号，实现了策略与其环境的持续、定向共进化。

summary: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an agent through a multi-step procedure. Workflow-following systems support prescribed process execution, but primarily target workflow completion rather than safeguarding agent behavior. PolicyGuide instead compiles each domain policy into a workflow graph and invokes a proactive verifier at user-turn boundaries. From persisted graph state, the verifier reconciles open requests and returns step-specific remediation along a policy-compliant path. Across the $τ^2$-bench airline, retail, and telecom domains with a GPT-5.4 agent and verifier, PolicyGuide raises mean $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ from $0.42$ to $0.62$, with the largest gain on telecom ($0.19$ to $0.61$), the most workflow-structured domain. The same workflows transfer to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Pro agents. Complementary evaluations find the lowest observed attack-success rate under adversarial users and the strongest procedural compliance in an author-designed workflow-level validation.
title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
title_translated: PolicyGuide：从守护单一动作到引导完整工作流的政策合规LLM智能体
summary_translated: 客户服务类LLM智能体在代表用户行动时必须遵守组织政策。合规失败可能源于禁止操作（如授予不符合资格的变更）或遗漏程序要求（如身份验证或确认）。运行时防护机制可干预高风险操作，但局部动作检查无法指导多步骤流程。工作流遵循系统支持预定流程的执行，但主要关注流程完成而非保护智能体行为。PolicyGuide则将每个领域政策编译为工作流图，并在用户回合边界调用主动验证器。基于持久化的图状态，验证器协调未决请求，并返回沿政策合规路径的特定步骤修复建议。在包含航空、零售和电信领域的$τ^2$-bench测试中，使用GPT-5.4智能体与验证器，PolicyGuide将平均$$\mathrm{Pass}^4$$从0.42提升至0.62，其中电信领域提升最大（从0.19到0.61），该领域具有最结构化的工作流。相同工作流可迁移至Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 2.5 Pro智能体。补充评估显示，在对抗性用户下攻击成功率最低，且在作者设计的工作流级验证中表现出最强的程序合规性。

summary: Medical image captioning is a technique that accelerates early-stage diagnostic workflows and enhances the interpretability of medical diagnostic AI systems. However, unlike general image captioning, clinically reliable captioning remains challenging due to grayscale-based modalities, subtle anatomical cues, specialized medical phrasing, and variations in data quality. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models, fluent outputs do not necessarily guarantee sufficient alignment with clinical concept spaces or evaluation criteria. To address this issue, we propose a framework that strengthens clinical alignment by separating and enhancing training-time alignment and inference-time alignment. We build a medical image captioning pipeline that integrates single/dual vision encoders based on BioMedCLIP and SigLIP2, a Q-Former, and a LLaMA-based decoder, and examine the contribution of auxiliary learning for UMLS concept/type prediction. At inference, we apply single-embedding-based reranking to select the best caption among candidates, while at training we introduce MedPAIR-SCST, which combines clinically relevant rewards to shift the generative distribution toward improved clinical alignment. Our experiments show that complementary visual representations with a multi-encoder design and concept-level auxiliary learning help preserve clinically meaningful information. Furthermore, inference-time reranking provides a practical way to improve semantic and clinical alignment without additional training, whereas MedPAIR-SCST goes beyond selection by directly improving the model's distribution to generate more consistent and clinically grounded captions. These findings suggest that jointly leveraging selection-based alignment and reinforcement-learning-based alignment can promote more trustworthy medical image captioning even in data-constrained settings.
title: Towards Clinically Faithful Medical Image Captioning via Enhanced Vision-Language Alignment

title_translated: 通过增强视觉-语言对齐实现临床忠实的医学图像描述
summary_translated: 医学图像描述技术可加速早期诊断流程并提升医疗AI系统的可解释性。然而，与通用图像描述不同，临床可靠的描述仍具挑战性，原因包括基于灰度的模态、细微解剖线索、专业医学术语以及数据质量差异。尽管大型视觉-语言模型取得进展，流畅输出并不保证与临床概念空间或评估标准充分对齐。为此，我们提出一种框架，通过分离并增强训练阶段与推理阶段的对齐来强化临床对齐。构建了一个集成BioMedCLIP和SigLIP2单/双视觉编码器、Q-Former及基于LLaMA的解码器的医学图像描述流水线，并研究UMLS概念/类型预测的辅助学习贡献。推理时采用基于单嵌入重排序的方法从候选描述中选择最优结果；训练时引入MedPAIR-SCST，结合临床相关奖励以调整生成分布，提升临床对齐性。实验表明，多编码器设计带来的互补视觉表示和概念级辅助学习有助于保留临床有意义信息。此外，推理阶段的重排序无需额外训练即可有效提升语义与临床对齐，而MedPAIR-SCST则通过直接优化模型分布生成更一致且临床基础牢固的描述。这些发现表明，联合利用基于选择的对齐与基于强化学习的对齐，可在数据受限情况下促进更可信的医学图像描述。

summary: Credit assignment is challenging in long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning, where supervision often comes only from final rewards. Existing methods refine trajectory-level signals into step-level credits through step grouping or graph-based advantage estimation, but can overlook meaningful intermediate milestones. We propose MileGPO (Milestone Inference with Local Evidence for Graph-Based Policy Optimization), which derives process-level credit from grouped on-policy rollouts through three designs. Milestone Discovery identifies candidate milestones on successful rollouts and recurring traps on failed ones. Reliability-Calibrated Shaping (RCS) weights these candidates by outcome-based confidence, strengthening reliable milestones and traps while down-weighting uncertain ones. Progress-Contrastive Calibration (PCC) further tests whether a candidate reflects local progress and whether its incoming ansition outperforms observed alternatives from the same state.MileGPO requires neither auxiliary models nor additional environment interaction. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show state-of-the-art performance and a small in-distribution to out-of-distribution gap on ALFWorld. Ablations and credit diagnostics indicate that reliability weighting, local progress, and same-state branch evidence complement milestone discovery and resolve ambiguous intermediate credit.
title: MileGPO: Milestone Inference with Local Evidence for Graph-Based Policy Optimization of Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_translated: MileGPO：基于局部证据的里程碑推理用于长周期LLM智能体的图结构策略优化
summary_translated: 在长周期代理强化学习中，信用分配极具挑战性，因为监督信号通常仅来自最终奖励。现有方法通过步骤分组或基于图的优势估计将轨迹级信号细化为步骤级信用，但可能忽略有意义的中间里程碑。我们提出MileGPO（基于图结构策略优化的里程碑推理与局部证据），通过三种设计从有策略回放的分组轨迹中推导过程级信用。里程碑发现识别成功回放中的候选里程碑及失败回放中的重复陷阱；可靠性校准塑造（RCS）根据结果置信度加权这些候选项，强化可靠里程碑与陷阱，降低不确定项权重；进度对比校准（PCC）进一步检验候选项是否反映局部进展，以及其进入转移是否优于同一状态下的其他观测替代方案。MileGPO无需辅助模型或额外环境交互。在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明其达到当前最佳性能，且在ALFWorld上表现出较小的分布内到分布外差距。消融实验与信用诊断表明，可靠性加权、局部进展判断及同状态分支证据共同补充了里程碑发现，解决了中间信用模糊问题。

summary: Audited against causal ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals used to train LLM agents -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- identifies which steps causally matter better than chance. Existing evaluations grade these signals against annotated step *correctness*; we audit them against step *contribution* -- what re-sampling the policy's own alternatives at each decision point and rolling forward actually changes about the outcome -- and the two come apart. The ground truth itself is structured: causal contribution is sparse (30.5% of decision points where ground truth is defined carry measurable effect), and measurability is model-dependent -- the fraction of points with no policy-supported counterfactual differs by a factor of two (13.1% vs. 26.8%) between two similar-scale policies. The failure mode is identifiable: implicit credit echoes the policy's fluency (median rank correlation +0.75, replicating at +0.70 in a second family under a corrected instrument), while conditioning on the outcome adds no causal information (partial correlation -0.004, Qwen). A confidence-only router recovers pivotal steps at chance level, but cuts judge cost by 13.1% per turn (14.0% per trajectory). In a seven-arm pre-registered training experiment, no arm reliably outperforms the untrained policy, and the checkpoints' apparent instrument signature is fully explained by training dose -- sparser credit retains fewer examples, an order-of-magnitude spread in optimizer steps -- not credit content. Comparisons of credit rules must therefore match effective sample size, or they measure dose, not credit.
title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

title_translated: 无真实因果依据的信用审计：基于执行回放的LLM智能体步骤级信用分配审计
summary_translated: 在单智能体工具环境（ALFWorld）中，基于已执行回放的因果真实情况对LLM智能体训练所用的步骤级信用信号进行审计，结果显示：LLM裁判评分、基于结果的对数概率比或策略自身置信度均无法比随机水平更好地识别出因果上重要的步骤。现有评估将这些信号与标注的步骤“正确性”对比；我们则将其与步骤“贡献度”对比——即在每个决策点重新采样策略自身的替代选项并向前推进，实际对结果产生的影响。两者存在显著差异。真实情况本身具有结构性：因果贡献稀疏（30.5%的决策点定义了可测量影响），且可测性依赖于模型——两个相似规模策略中，无策略支持反事实的点占比相差两倍（13.1% vs. 26.8%）。失败模式可识别：隐含信用反映策略流畅性（中位秩相关+0.75，在另一家族中复现+0.70，经修正仪器后），而基于结果的条件化并未增加因果信息（偏相关-0.004，Qwen）。仅依赖置信度的路由机制仅能以随机水平恢复关键步骤，但每轮可节省13.1%的裁判成本（每轨迹14.0%）。在七臂预注册训练实验中，没有任何一组方法稳定优于未经训练的策略，且检查点的表观仪器特征完全由训练剂量解释——更稀疏的信用保留更少样本，优化器步数相差一个数量级，而非信用内容。因此，信用规则比较必须匹配有效样本量，否则衡量的是剂量而非信用本身。

summary: Inference-time selection methods, such as Best-of-N, improve generation by sampling a pool of candidates and selecting the top-ranked completion according to a reward model. Distillation seeks to amortize this procedure into a single policy by replacing raw rewards with in-pool ranks and learning a policy that upweights higher-ranked completions. However, existing rank-based policies typically use smooth full-support reweighting, so low-ranked completions receive less mass but remain in the target support. Although a sharper reweighting reduces lower-tail mass, it also increases reliance on brittle ranking at the top made by a single reward model. We propose TUP: a Truncate-bad, Upweight-good Policy that removes low-ranked completions from the support and reweights only the retained upper tail with a tunable sharpness. TUP admits a closed-form, prompt-independent normalization and can be trained fully offline via binary cross-entropy, using shifted-truncated win-rates as soft labels and distilled-to-reference log-likelihood ratios as logits. Theoretically, under certain assumptions, we show that for any unknown oracle reward, the best monotone rank-reweighting can be matched by a lower-tail truncation rule, providing formal support for removing the lower tail rather than merely downweighting it. Empirically, we show that TUP is competitive with strong offline alignment baselines.
title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification
title_translated: 剔除差者，优者加权：基于排名分类的BoN风格蒸馏
summary_translated: 推理阶段的选择方法（如Best-of-N）通过采样候选池并根据奖励模型选择最高排名的完成结果来提升生成质量。蒸馏旨在将这一过程转化为单一策略，通过将原始奖励替换为池内排名，并训练一个对更高排名完成结果加权的策略。然而，现有基于排名的策略通常采用平滑全支撑重加权，导致低排名结果虽被减重但仍保留在目标支持集中。虽然更尖锐的重加权可减少尾部质量，但也增加了对单一奖励模型顶部脆弱排名的依赖。我们提出TUP：一种“剔除差者，优者加权”的策略，将低排名完成结果从支持集移除，并对保留的上尾部分进行可调尖锐度重加权。TUP具备闭式、提示无关的归一化形式，可通过二元交叉熵完全离线训练，使用移位截断胜率作为软标签，以及蒸馏目标与参考模型的对数似然比作为logits。理论上，在某些假设下，我们证明对于任意未知的最优奖励函数，最佳单调排名重加权可由下尾截断规则匹配，为移除下尾而非仅降权提供了正式支持。实证上，TUP在性能上可媲美强大的离线对齐基线。

summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding and reasoning. Despite extensive studies on text- and image-based jailbreaks, video jailbreaks against LVLMs remain largely unexplored. Existing video jailbreak methods mainly manipulate textual content embedded in videos, while overlooking how such information is organized over time. Our analysis reveals that jailbreak effectiveness depends not only on the semantics of textual information but also on its temporal presentation, including duration and timing-slot allocation. Motivated by this finding, we use subtitles, which are common in real-world videos and allow semantic content to be presented under precise temporal control without appearing visually intrusive, as a natural attack medium. Based on this insight, we propose TempJail, a black-box video-based jailbreak framework that constructs query-aligned dialogue-style subtitle sequences and optimizes their temporal scheduling to exploit temporal vulnerabilities in LVLMs and elicit responses that satisfy the harmful intent of the source query. Extensive experiments on four representative LVLMs and two datasets demonstrate that TempJail achieves the highest attack success rate across all evaluated model--dataset settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 53 and 18 percentage points in dataset-averaged ASR on GPT-5 and Gemini 3.5-Flash, respectively.
title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling
title_translated: TempJail：通过字幕调度对大型视觉-语言模型的时序越狱攻击
summary_translated: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在视频理解与推理方面取得了显著进展。尽管已有大量关于文本和图像越狱的研究，针对LVLMs的视频越狱仍基本未被探索。现有视频越狱方法主要操纵嵌入视频中的文本内容，而忽略了这些信息在时间上的组织方式。我们的分析表明，越狱效果不仅取决于文本信息的语义，还取决于其时间呈现方式，包括持续时间和时间槽分配。受此发现启发，我们使用字幕作为自然攻击媒介——字幕在真实视频中常见，可在不明显影响视觉的情况下精确控制语义内容的呈现。基于这一洞察，我们提出了TempJail，一种黑盒视频越狱框架，通过构建与查询对齐的对话式字幕序列并优化其时间调度，以利用LVLMs的时间漏洞，诱导出满足原始查询有害意图的响应。在四个代表性LVLMs和两个数据集上的大量实验表明，TempJail在所有评估的模型-数据集组合中均达到最高的攻击成功率，相较于最强基线，在GPT-5和Gemini 3.5-Flash的数据集平均攻击成功率上分别提升了53和18个百分点。

summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to causally update state as video arrives and organize growing history into semantic units that can evolve, persist, and be recalled under bounded computation and memory. This challenge is pronounced in live soccer commentary, where a system must describe completed events, summarize recent play, recall earlier events, or remain silent using only information available before each utterance. We present StreamSoccer, an event-driven system that uses event memory as its intermediate representation. A fixed-budget active memory integrates the stream; completed event states are retained locally and consolidated into retrievable historical records. A unified generator uses current, recent, and historical context to produce three commentary modes, while a rule-assisted scheduler selects a mode or silence. Unlike streaming video-language models organized around frames, visual tokens, or caches, and soccer-commentary methods based on predefined clips or output timestamps, StreamSoccer explicitly models event lifecycles. We construct a three-track streaming soccer commentary dataset and a layered evaluation protocol. At common reference anchors, StreamSoccer obtains CIDEr scores of 38.62, 23.96, and 17.39 for current-event, recent-window, and historical-memory commentary, ranking first on the current-event and historical-memory tracks and second on recent-window. Controlled ablations show that local completed events improve all tracks and that the full system performs best on all three. Across 174 raw-video runs on 58 matches, per-minute RTF p95 ranges from 0.10 to 0.22 without sustained growth with match history. These results indicate that event memory supports streaming soccer commentary across temporal scopes while controlling long-history computation.
title: StreamSoccer: Event-Driven Memory for Streaming Soccer Commentary
title_translated: StreamSoccer：面向流式足球解说的事件驱动记忆
summary_translated: 流式视频理解要求模型在视频数据到达时因果地更新状态，并将不断增长的历史信息组织为可演化、可持久且能在有限计算与内存条件下被召回的语义单元。这一挑战在实时足球解说中尤为突出，系统必须仅基于每个话语前可用的信息，描述已完成事件、总结近期比赛、回忆早期事件或保持沉默。我们提出StreamSoccer，一种以事件记忆为中间表示的事件驱动系统。固定预算的主动记忆整合了数据流；已完成事件的状态在本地保留，并合并为可检索的历史记录。统一生成器利用当前、近期和历史上下文生成三种解说模式，规则辅助调度器则选择模式或沉默。与围绕帧、视觉标记或缓存组织的流式视频-语言模型，以及基于预定义片段或输出时间戳的足球解说方法不同，StreamSoccer显式建模事件生命周期。我们构建了一个三轨流式足球解说数据集和分层评估协议。在常见参考锚点处，StreamSoccer在当前事件、近期窗口和历史记忆解说任务上的CIDEr得分分别为38.62、23.96和17.39，分别在当前事件和历史记忆赛道排名第一，在近期窗口赛道排名第二。受控消融实验表明，本地完成事件改善了所有赛道表现，完整系统在三项任务上均表现最佳。在58场比赛的174次原始视频运行中，每分钟RTF p95范围为0.10至0.22，且随比赛历史无持续增长。结果表明，事件记忆在跨时间尺度支持流式足球解说的同时，有效控制了长历史计算开销。

summary: As LLM-based agents are deployed for longer and higher-stakes tasks, their memory systems continue to have crucial gaps. While existing memory benchmarks focus largely on recall-shaped tasks, we argue an effective memory system must track the evolving state of the world; as facts, constraints, and decisions are revised over a long interaction, answers must reflect the current state and not a superseded one. We define this capability as state tracking and instantiate it in StateMemBench, a benchmark of 234 multi-session scenarios spanning two conversation-length regimes. Its closed-pool grading scores whether an answer reflects the current state, the superseded state, or fails otherwise, separating state-tracking failures from other errors by construction. Our analysis shows that this task is challenging for existing memory systems, retrieval-augmented baselines, and long-context baselines. We then present StateMem, a state-first memory method that explicitly tracks supersession and relational dependencies, and show it improves current-state accuracy over the strongest same-backbone baseline by 1.8x (0.205 -> 0.363) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and over the strongest memory system by 1.6x (0.149 -> 0.233) on Qwen-3.5-9B, while remaining competitive with the long-context baselines. Finally, we show the same state approach can be applied as a lightweight single-call wrapper over existing memory systems, lifting current-state accuracy by +32 to +67 points on StateMemBench across six memory and retrieval backends. A length- and cost-matched control attributes +15 to +32 of those points to state structure rather than added context.
title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
title_translated: 智能体记忆系统能否追踪动态状态？
summary_translated: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体被部署于更长时间、更高风险的任务中，其记忆系统仍存在关键缺陷。现有记忆基准大多聚焦于回忆类任务，我们认为一个有效的记忆系统必须能够追踪世界状态的演变；随着事实、约束和决策在长期交互中不断更新，回答必须反映当前状态而非过时状态。我们定义这一能力为状态追踪，并在StateMemBench基准中实现，该基准包含234个跨两个对话长度区间的多会话场景。其封闭池评分机制判断答案是否反映当前状态、过时状态或失败，通过构造将状态追踪失败与其他错误区分开来。我们的分析显示，该任务对现有记忆系统、基于检索增强的基线及长上下文基线均具挑战性。随后，我们提出StateMem，一种以状态优先的记忆方法，显式追踪过时关系与依赖关系，并在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上相比最强同架构基线将当前状态准确率提升1.8倍（0.205 → 0.363），在Qwen-3.5-9B上相比最强记忆系统提升1.6倍（0.149 → 0.233），同时保持与长上下文基线的竞争力。最后，我们证明该状态方法可作为轻量级单调用包装器应用于现有记忆系统，使StateMemBench上的当前状态准确率提升+32至+67分，六种记忆与检索后端均适用。长度与成本匹配的对照实验表明，其中+15至+32分归因于状态结构本身，而非额外上下文。

summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as an effective approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, its adaptation to multimodal settings remains unexplored. Through representational analysis, we identify a key limitation in multimodal preference optimization, which we term visual insensitivity: models often fail to distinguish between images and those with critical visual context removed. Our theoretical analysis further uncovers two manifestations of this problem, namely Across-Image Insensitivity and Within-Image Insensitivity. To address these challenges, we propose Perception-Enhanced Alignment DPO (PEA-DPO), a framework for multimodal LLMs alignment, which explicitly leverages visual preference signals to overcome visual insensitivity. We further provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that PEA-DPO provably mitigates both failure modes. Empirical results demonstrate that PEA-DPO enhances sensitivity to visual context while preserving the language modeling capacity of the base model. Evaluations across three hallucination benchmarks using MLLMs of varying scales show that PEA-DPO effectively mitigates visual insensitivity, achieves stronger multimodal alignment, and substantially reduces hallucinations.
title: PEA-DPO: Perception-Enhanced Alignment Direct Preference Optimization for MLLMs Alignment
title_translated: PEA-DPO：感知增强型对齐直接偏好优化用于多模态大语言模型对齐
summary_translated: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为对齐大语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好的有效方法。然而，其在多模态场景下的应用仍处于空白。通过表征分析，我们识别出多模态偏好优化中的一个关键局限，称为视觉不敏感性：模型常无法区分图像与其关键视觉上下文被移除后的版本。我们的理论分析进一步揭示了该问题的两种表现形式，即跨图像不敏感性和图像内不敏感性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出感知增强型对齐DPO（PEA-DPO），一种用于多模态LLMs对齐的框架，通过显式利用视觉偏好信号来克服视觉不敏感性。我们进一步提供理论分析，证明PEA-DPO可严格缓解这两种失败模式。实证结果表明，PEA-DPO增强了对视觉上下文的敏感性，同时保持了基础模型的语言建模能力。在不同规模的多模态大语言模型上，通过三个幻觉基准的评估显示，PEA-DPO有效缓解了视觉不敏感性，实现了更强的多模态对齐，并显著减少幻觉。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language-model responses by grounding generation in external passages, which comes with overhead: retrieved context lengthens the prompt, increasing prefill work, KV-cache footprint, memory traffic, latency, and energy. Context compression offers a natural remedy by pruning retrieved text before generation. However, state-of-the-art context-compression methods are typically used with a fixed compression budget, or with the rate selected offline and then applied at inference time. This static view ignores both workload variation and the live state of the edge device. On an edge SoC, compression is not free: the compressor itself runs on the same SoC and consumes latency and energy that can offset any generation savings.   This paper proposes a vision for telemetry-informed adaptive compression in edge RAG, grounded in experimental evidence. We characterize the compression tradeoff on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor using Llama and Qwen generators, Natural Questions and HotpotQA datasets, and LLMLingua-2 compression. Our measurements show that generation dominates the RAG budget for larger models, reaching roughly 90% of per-query latency and 91% of GPU energy for 7B-8B generators. Exploring the impact of the compression rate reveals an adaptive operating region: mild compression can miss energy opportunities, and overly aggressive compression can hurt inference quality. Intermediate compression can reduce GPU energy by up to 53.2%, and SoC energy by up to 48.2%, with negligible quality loss. We argue for runtime policies that dynamically manage compression, guided by workload features and edge telemetry.
title: From Retrieved Context to Runtime Control: Adaptive Compression for Edge-based RAG

title_translated: 从检索上下文到运行时控制：面向边缘RAG的自适应压缩
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成过程锚定在外部段落中，提升了语言模型的响应质量，但带来了开销：检索到的上下文延长了提示长度，增加了预填充工作量、KV缓存占用、内存流量、延迟和能耗。上下文压缩通过在生成前修剪检索文本提供了自然的解决方案。然而，最先进的上下文压缩方法通常采用固定的压缩预算，或在离线选择压缩率并在推理时应用。这种静态视角忽略了工作负载变化和边缘设备的实时状态。在边缘SoC上，压缩并非免费：压缩器本身运行在同一SoC上，消耗的延迟和能量可能抵消任何生成节省。本文提出一种基于实验证据的遥测驱动自适应压缩愿景。我们在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor平台上，使用Llama和Qwen生成器、Natural Questions和HotpotQA数据集以及LLMLingua-2压缩方法，刻画了压缩权衡。测量结果显示，对于较大模型，生成占RAG预算的主导地位，达到每查询延迟的约90%和7B-8B生成器GPU能耗的91%。探索压缩率的影响揭示了一个自适应操作区域：轻微压缩可能错失节能机会，过度激进的压缩则会损害推理质量。适度压缩可使GPU能耗降低高达53.2%，SoC能耗降低高达48.2%，且质量损失可忽略。我们主张采用由工作负载特征和边缘遥测引导的运行时策略，动态管理压缩。

summary: AI clones that imitate a specific person typically reproduce what the person says and how they sound, but not how they listen. We investigate whether adding multimodal listening behaviors gives such a clone more presence and authenticity. We integrated verbal backchannels and head nodding, driven by real-time prediction models, into an AI clone equipped with voice cloning and LLM-based responses. In a within-subjects study (N=35), adding these behaviors significantly improved the perceived attentiveness of the avatar, the sense of talking with the real person, and the feeling of co-presence. These results indicate that AI clone fidelity should extend beyond voice and response content to include interactive listening behavior.
title: Does Listening Matter? Backchanneling and Nodding in AI Clone
comment: This paper has been accepted to the Late-Breaking Results (LBR) track of the 28th International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI 2026)
title_translated: 倾听重要吗？AI克隆中的反馈回应与点头行为
summary_translated: 能够模仿特定人物的AI克隆通常能复现该人物所说的内容及其语音特征，但无法复现其倾听方式。我们研究了在AI克隆中加入多模态倾听行为是否能增强其存在感和真实性。我们在一个具备语音克隆和基于大语言模型响应能力的AI克隆系统中，集成了由实时预测模型驱动的言语反馈和头部点头行为。在一项被试内实验（N=35）中，添加这些行为显著提升了用户对虚拟形象专注度的感知、与真实人物对话的感觉以及共在感。结果表明，AI克隆的真实性应超越语音和响应内容，延伸至交互式倾听行为。

summary: Most modern optimizers form their momentum as an exponential moving average (EMA) of past gradients, forgetting every direction at one fixed rate. However, the inputs a deep network sees during training can be highly anisotropic, with a few directions queried frequently while most are seen rarely. Recent methods address this anisotropy by wrapping extra processing around this buffer, leaving the momentum update itself unchanged. We propose DeltaMomentum, which builds direction-awareness into the momentum update rule. The main observation is that the gradient of a linear layer splits into an input that acts as a key and an output-side error that acts as a value. Exploiting the key-value structure, DeltaMomentum updates the momentum buffer by the canonical delta rule, so each direction is forgotten at a rate set by how often it appears. We prove that it is a valid momentum, that it applies the input-side curvature correction without matrix inversion, and that it clears stale directions faster than EMA under both a fixed and a drifting optimum. It is a drop-in replacement for the momentum buffer of any optimizer, its coefficient transfers across widths under $μ$P, and its extra compute stays between $22.2\%$ and $25.0\%$ of a gated-MLP block's linear cost with no persistent memory. In FineWeb-Edu pretraining, AdamW with DeltaMomentum (DeltaAdamW) reaches AdamW's validation loss in up to $46.39 \pm 4.32\%$ fewer steps at 67M and $22.12 \pm 0.80\%$ at 370M over three seeds, and the gain persists at 1B on a Chinchilla-optimal budget. A Muon baseline tuned under the same protocol sits above DeltaAdamW at both language-model scales, and the gain holds for SGD, ResNet-18, and ViT-Tiny on CIFAR-10. Training-time diagnostics confirm the predicted mechanism, better gradient tracking and healthier input directions.
title: DeltaMomentum: A Key-Value based Anisotropic Momentum Update via Delta Rule
title_translated: DeltaMomentum：基于Delta规则的键值型各向异性动量更新
summary_translated: 大多数现代优化器将动量表示为过去梯度的指数移动平均（EMA），以固定速率遗忘所有方向。然而，深度网络在训练过程中所接收的输入具有高度各向异性，少数方向频繁出现，而大多数方向很少被访问。现有方法通过在缓冲区外增加额外处理来应对这种各向异性，但保持动量更新规则不变。我们提出DeltaMomentum，将方向感知能力直接融入动量更新规则。核心观察是：线性层的梯度可分解为作为‘键’的输入和作为‘值’的输出侧误差。利用键值结构，DeltaMomentum采用标准的Delta规则更新动量缓冲区，使每个方向的遗忘速率由其出现频率决定。我们证明该方法是有效的动量机制，无需矩阵求逆即可实现输入侧曲率校正，并在固定和漂移最优解下比EMA更快清除过时方向。它可作为任何优化器动量缓冲区的即插即用替代品，其系数在μP条件下跨宽度迁移，额外计算成本仅为门控MLP块线性部分的22.2%至25.0%，且无持久内存开销。在FineWeb-Edu预训练中，使用DeltaMomentum的AdamW（DeltaAdamW）在67M规模上比AdamW少46.39±4.32%的步骤达到相同验证损失，在370M规模上减少22.12±0.80%，且在1B规模上于Chinchilla最优预算下仍保持优势。在同一协议下调优的Muon基线在两个语言模型规模上均低于DeltaAdamW，且该优势在SGD、ResNet-18和ViT-Tiny在CIFAR-10上的表现中也成立。训练期诊断确认了预测机制，显示更好的梯度追踪能力和更健康的输入方向。

summary: This work introduces a formal semantic-block model for specifications and an execution-judged benchmark for evaluating specification quality independently of model capability. A specification is represented as a structure comprising semantic blocks, dependency relations, block-owned rules, decision points, and explicitly open questions, subject to four machine-checkable well-formedness conditions: acyclicity, single ownership, constraint domination, and totality or ambiguity-stop. Determinacy is defined model-theoretically as agreement among all conforming implementations and is estimated empirically through convergence across independent implementers. The model is instantiated on an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration specification containing 18 blocks and 19 dependency edges. Computational validation shows that the five-layer decomposition reduces mean per-task context by approximately 71% through dependency closures, covers 85.5% of the study-defined Oracle construct taxonomy with all identified gaps triaged, is not Pareto-dominated by the tested alternative partitions, and is recovered at the 99.9th percentile from citation-derived edges not used to define the original structure. The benchmark keeps the implementer panel fixed, includes a mandatory no-specification control arm, and uses PostgreSQL 16 and a live Oracle instance as deterministic execution judges. Six designed studies, including three pre-registered manipulations and three diagnostic analyses, further examine specification effects. Repeated runs on a 25-unit subsample reveal an empirical variability floor with a median arm-delta spread of 14.4 percentage points. The results support determinacy as a formal concept but not as a standalone empirical quality metric for the evaluated contemporary LLM implementers.
title: Measuring What a Specification Determines: A Formal Semantic-Block Model and an Execution-Judged Benchmark
title_translated: 衡量规范所决定的内容：一种形式化语义块模型与执行判断基准
summary_translated: 本文提出一种用于规范的形式化语义块模型，以及一种独立于模型能力的规范质量评估执行判断基准。规范被建模为包含语义块、依赖关系、块拥有规则、决策点及显式开放问题的结构，并满足四个可机器验证的良构性条件：无环性、单一所有权、约束支配性和完全性或歧义终止。确定性通过模型论定义为所有符合实现的一致性，并通过独立实现者之间的收敛进行经验估计。该模型应用于一个包含18个块和19条依赖边的Oracle到PostgreSQL迁移规范。计算验证显示，五层分解通过依赖闭包将每任务上下文平均减少约71%，覆盖研究定义的Oracle构造分类法的85.5%，所有识别出的缺口均已处理，且未被测试的替代划分方案所占优，并可在引用衍生边（未用于定义原始结构）中以99.9百分位恢复。基准保持实现者小组固定，包含强制性的无规范对照组，并使用PostgreSQL 16和实时Oracle实例作为确定性执行裁判。六个设计研究（包括三个预先注册的操纵和三个诊断分析）进一步检验规范的影响。对25个单位子样本的重复运行揭示了一个经验变异性下限，中位数臂间差异为14.4个百分点。结果支持确定性作为形式概念，但不支持其作为当前主流LLM实现者独立的经验质量指标。

summary: Vulnerability prioritization is inherently preference dependent, since the same CVE can receive different remediation priority under different operational preference scenarios. Existing scoring systems and ranking methods typically assume a fixed criterion. In practice, organizations already operate under a preference scenario, but this preference is often implicit and difficult to express as a written prompt instruction, while triage queries usually do not encode it. Past validated triage cases under the current scenario are more readily available. We study query-based CVE prioritization in this setting and propose HARP, a graph-grounded multi-view framework that ranks candidates from a natural-language query together with a support bank of historical labeled examples from the current preference scenario, without requiring an explicit textual summary of that scenario. HARP retrieves evidence from a vulnerability knowledge graph, scores candidates with policy-conditioned global, enterprise, and user views, and fits view-fusion weights from sampled supports. Experiments across three preference scenarios and multiple backbone LLMs show that HARP outperforms multiple baselines, expressing our method's effectiveness.
title: HARP: Hierarchical Adaptive Ranking with Preference-Adaptive Fusion for Query-Based CVE Prioritization
title_translated: HARP：基于偏好自适应融合的分层自适应排序用于基于查询的CVE优先级排序
summary_translated: 漏洞优先级排序本质上依赖于偏好，因为同一CVE在不同运营偏好场景下可能获得不同的修复优先级。现有评分系统和排序方法通常假设固定标准。实际上，组织已在某种偏好场景下运作，但该偏好往往隐含且难以表达为书面提示指令，而分类查询通常也不编码此偏好。过去在当前场景下已验证的分类案例则更容易获取。我们在此背景下研究基于查询的CVE优先级排序，并提出HARP——一种图基多视角框架，它在无需明确文本总结当前场景的情况下，结合自然语言查询与当前偏好场景的历史标注示例库对候选项进行排序。HARP从漏洞知识图谱中检索证据，使用政策条件化的全局、企业及用户视角对候选项打分，并从采样的支持样本中拟合视角融合权重。在三种偏好场景和多个骨干LLM上的实验表明，HARP优于多个基线方法，体现了本方法的有效性。

summary: When a tool call times out, the agent sees the failure and can route around it. A cached error page or negative price can instead arrive in the expected format and be consumed as fact. We introduce Outcome Monitors, which detect violations of outcome contracts mined from task-disjoint traces or derived from public schemas. On a violation, the monitor preserves the result and issues a nonbinding receipt naming the violated property and public recovery tools. In frozen, prespecified evaluations with injected failures, Outcome Monitors raise ToolMaze completion from 10.9% to 28.1% across four models in two provider families and replicate in a third. In tau-bench retail, completion improves by 14.0 and 12.0 points on two tiers. In separate ToolMaze controls, removing the recovery-tool list eliminates the measured gain and restoring it recovers the effect; diagnostic detail and timing produce no detectable differences. Gains concentrate where the fault blocks completion. On a suite transcribed from a published incident taxonomy, detection outside the mined vocabulary falls to 46%, though delivery continues and completion is unchanged. Recovery tools are the active receipt content in these controls; extending detection beyond the contract vocabulary remains open.
title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures

title_translated: 结果监控器：沉默工具故障的恢复支持机制
summary_translated: 当工具调用超时时，智能体可察觉失败并绕行。但缓存的错误页面或负价格可能以预期格式返回并被当作事实消费。我们引入结果监控器（Outcome Monitors），用于检测从任务无关轨迹中挖掘或从公开模式推导出的结果契约违规。一旦发生违规，监控器保留结果并发出非约束性收据，指明被违反的属性及公开的恢复工具。在冻结、预设的评估中注入故障，结果监控器将ToolMaze完成率从10.9%提升至28.1%，覆盖四个模型和两个供应商系列，并在第三个系列中复现。在tau-bench零售基准中，两个层级的完成率分别提升14.0和12.0分。在独立的ToolMaze对照实验中，移除恢复工具列表会消除测量收益，恢复后效果重现；诊断细节和时间无明显差异。收益集中在故障阻塞完成的关键位置。在一套源自已发表事件分类体系的测试套件中，超出挖掘词汇范围的检测率降至46%，尽管交付继续且完成率不变。在这些对照中，恢复工具是收据的活跃内容；将检测扩展至契约词汇之外仍待探索。

summary: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial. We formulate this tradeoff as active inference for context acquisition. An inner inference step updates beliefs over a latent task state, and an outer decision selects the next context action, task action, or stop action to minimize expected free energy under cost. In deterministic settings, the epistemic term reduces to expected information gain, optionally normalized by token cost. We instantiate the framework in Optimal Question Asking (OQA), with exact posteriors and a dynamic programming oracle, and benchmark frontier language models on binary and multiway categorical tasks from 25 to 300 candidates. We also study clarification before generation and automated prompt optimization under token budgets. The formulation is model-agnostic and views active inference as a design principle for the context-acquisition layer of AI agents.
title: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
title_translated: 主动推理作为AI智能体的上下文获取方法
summary_translated: 交互式AI智能体必须尽可能高效地获取正确的上下文。当用户遗漏了约束条件、偏好、文件或任务变量时，智能体可以选择基于默认假设继续执行，或消耗资源提出澄清问题、进行检索调用、工具调用或提示试验。我们将其权衡关系建模为用于上下文获取的主动推理。内部推断步骤更新对潜在任务状态的信念，外部决策则选择下一步的上下文操作、任务操作或停止操作，以在成本约束下最小化预期自由能。在确定性环境下，认识论项简化为预期信息增益，可选地按令牌成本进行归一化。我们在最优提问（OQA）框架中实现了该方法，采用精确后验和动态规划预言机，并在包含25至300个候选项的二元及多分类任务上对前沿语言模型进行了基准测试。我们还研究了生成前的澄清策略以及在令牌预算下的自动提示优化。该框架具有模型无关性，将主动推理视为AI智能体上下文获取层的设计原则。
